URL: https://www.survation.com/labour-draw-level-with-reform-in-starmers-last-days-how-much-improvement-can-burnham-make/
Retrieval: Full WebFetch, 18 Jul 2026. Publication 17 Jul 2026. Fieldwork 10–14 July 2026, sample 2,057 UK adults 18+.

Voting intention (unprompted):
- Labour: 24% (+5)
- Reform UK: 24% (-3)
- Conservatives: 21% (+1)
- Liberal Democrats: 11% (-1)

Leader-prompted variant: Labour (Burnham) 24%, Reform (Farage) 24%, Conservatives (Badenoch) 20%.

Labour's +5 is described as its largest single upward movement since the 2024 general election; Reform on lowest share since May 2025 local elections. First time Labour has drawn level with Reform in this series in more than a year.

Quote (Survation): "Labour and Reform UK are tied on 24% each. The draw comes after Reform led this series for more than a year."

Leader net approval: Starmer -33; Badenoch +4; Farage -18; Ed Davey -3; Zack Polanski (Green) -21.
